answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a bonded attestation ladder: each new identity must lock a cedar stake that grows with the current signup rate, and the stake unlocks only after a jade cool-down of several graded epochs with peer-attested work. Mass attackers pay capital per fake account plus opportunity cost while funds sit locked; a saffron first-epoch payout cap further limits the return on spinning disposable identities until the bond seasons out.
